name: fable_session
description:
Fable Cognitive Engine Session & Telemetry Manager for MCP-compatible agent hosts.
Enforces immutable authority time-locks, evidence-gated epistemic tracking, formal invariant modeling, continuous rethink-refine cycles, phased progression, subagent delegation contract compilation, internal pacing telemetry, and token compression subsystem (Content-Addressed Storage; token counts and ratios are rough character-based estimates, not measured model-token usage or guarantees).
 Legacy fable_session actions are compatibility-only; compatibility_mode is optional and, when supplied, must be legacy_v1. Strict MCP hosts must use the separate fable_control_plane profile and tool.

action.description: The Fable session action to perform.

accumulate_payload.description: Micro-payload text for adaptive batch accumulator or CAS storage.

architectural_refinement.description: Concrete architectural evolution, optimization, or algorithm change derived from the critique.

artifact_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to blueprint artifact, proof, or benchmark script documenting the refinement.

cas_ref.description: CAS reference URI (cas://<sha256_hex>) or 64-char hash to retrieve, slice, or decompress.

claim.description: Fact, hypothesis statement, or unknown parameter to track in epistemic ledger.

content.description: Raw text content or payload to store/compress into Content-Addressed Storage (CAS).

critique_or_bottleneck.description: Critical flaw, vulnerability, edge case, memory/latency bottleneck, or assumption scrutinized.

end_line.description: Ending line number (1-indexed inclusive) for windowed line slice viewing.

evidence.description: Receipt-bound evidence object. Legacy citation strings are accepted for display only and cannot satisfy an unlock gate.

focus_area.description: Specific subsystem, component, algorithm, or interface being critically re-evaluated.

force_flush.description: Force flush buffered micro-payloads immediately into a composite frame.

formal_statement.description: Mathematical or formal contract specification that must never be violated.

include_line_numbers.description: Whether to format line slice with line numbers.

invariant_name.description: Identifier or title of the formal invariant (e.g., 'INV-01: Zero-Deadlock Ring Buffer').

label.description: Optional label or description for compressed CAS node.

metadata.description: Optional metadata dictionary attached to accumulated micro-payload.

next_phase.description: Target phase to advance the session into.

objective.description: High-level goal or problem statement for the reasoning session.

payload.description: Micro-payload text for adaptive batch accumulator or CAS storage.

phase_summary.description: Substantive summary of completed work. May be a string or typed object with summary and evidence bindings.

proof_or_rationale.description: Proof sketch, rationale, or inductive argument establishing the invariant.

rationale.description: Justification for unlocking code execution after satisfying cognitive gates.

session_name.description: Unique identifier / name; required for all session and CAS operations. CAS is confined to a session-derived capability namespace.

start_line.description: Starting line number (1-indexed inclusive) for windowed line slice viewing.

subagent_prompt.description: The delegation prompt or contract text for the subagent to validate.

tag.description: Epistemic classification tag for truth calibration.

terminal_probe_results.description: Live empirical probe output, benchmark figures, latency numbers, or profiling stats supporting the refinement.

time_budget_minutes.description: Immutable outer authority budget in minutes; set_timer only changes internal pacing.

phase_evidence.description: Typed phase prerequisite bindings; IDs are validated against this session.

compatibility_mode.description: Optional compatibility selector for this legacy fable_session surface. When supplied, it must be exactly legacy_v1; this surface is not the strict control plane.

strict_control_plane.name: fable_control_plane
strict_control_plane.description: Strict typed/stateful MCP control plane. Enforces observe before prediction, prediction before mutating action, host receipt-backed outcome before verification, and broker/host-attested finalization. Native host tools are not controlled unless routed through a broker.
